verdict.rationale: Deel is a payroll platform, so automatic year-end W-2 and 1099 generation and distribution is a fair question for it. The evidence pack only makes generic claims about 'compliant payroll' and 'automated compliance'. Nothing documents W-2 or 1099 generation, filing, or distribution to workers at year-end.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have W-2s and 1099s generated and distributed to workers automatically at year-end
